notes.title: Gameplay rework. Bye bye dash! Welcome checkpoints!
notes.notes:
This update introduces a few changes that impact the game enormously! 

[list]
[*] Dash has been removed
[*] Beginner mode added
[/list]

In this update we have removed the dash from the game. We found that the game became too easy at certain points where this was not our intended design. So we made the decision to remove the dash and put more focus on the main mechanic of kicking. Now your kicks matter more, so be cautious!

We have also added a beginner mode. This mode introduces checkpoints to help you complete the level. Leaderboard entries will be ignored in beginner mode and your best time won't be saved.


Be sure to test these features out and let us know what you think of them!
Feedback? -> [url=https://discord.gg/feVPh8Yeed]Join our Discord![/url]

notes.title: Win a Steam key! (..and more!)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Martial Artists!

The wait is over! After much anticipation, our newly revamped level is finally here, and to celebrate, we’re kicking things off with a special competition! Get ready for more action, more challenges, and plenty of chances to prove your skill! 💥

Our new level is[b] longer, tougher, and way more fun[/b], which means more opportunities for you to discover optimal routes and show off your speed-running prowess! 🏃‍♂️ But hold on, we’re mixing things up this time!

[b]Here’s the twist[/b]: We’re not just awarding the fastest player on the leaderboard with a Steam key. Oh no, we’re also giving [b]everyone[/b] [b]a chance to win[/b]! That’s right — even if your completion time is 8 hours, 16 minutes, and 4 seconds, you could still walk away with a Steam key. The leaderboard’s got room for both speed demons and slow-and-steady strategists!

But that’s not all… 

Join [b]our Hall of Fame[/b]! We’re building our community of playtesters for future levels, and we want dedicated fans like YOU! By helping us out, you can immortalize yourself in the game. We’re talking about:

[list]
[*] Your name on a skeleton! 💀
[*] Your dialogue as a skeleton character! 💬
[*] Even your own voice line in the game! 🎙️
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/59883c0e7203452580ec40f1027400f300f97e2f.png[/img]

The most dedicated fans will get to leave their mark and become a part of the game world! Want more details? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/AxrcGBJDwm]discord server[/url] and stay tuned for updates.

So, what are you waiting for?! Get in there, fight your way to the top, or take your time — either way, the rewards are waiting for you! 🔥

Good luck, warriors — may the fastest and the boldest win! 🏆

notes.title: Change of gameplay
notes.notes:
Hey there martial artists!

After some internal brainstorming we have decided to change our approach for level design, instead of the small individual levels we are making large levels which combine many of the elements of previous smaller levels. We feel that these levels will fit better with the main mechanic of the game and make it more enjoyable for casual players, while still keeping it's speed running aspects to it. Here is already a small showcase of the level and the other changes we made!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/9fe4b43b9da902e689fae9f2d4a76d7537b1bd82.gif[/img]

New features / changes: 
[list]
[*]Created one large level
[*]Improved the feeling and effects from kicking
[*]Added new skeletons that explain the mechanics and story
[*]Added a Satan voice that speak to the player and adds story to the game
[*]Player movement has been improved to feel better
[*]The performance of the game has greatly improved
[*]The replay model is now more transparent
[*]Improved UI: new buttons, text bar, ...
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/68b25efd0fc59eb440b9d16a8be4ea67830afda9.gif[/img]
So hop on Kick'n Hell and test the newest "Circle of Fraud" level and let us know in our Discord server, where we want to build an active and helpful community!

Furthermore have we launched the demo as a separate Steam page!! You can now review the game to leave your opinion for fellow players. It would help us out if you left a review so Kick'n Hell becomes more visible for other players.

Thanks for your support!

[url=https://discord.gg/AxrcGBJDwm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/0d4d05ec38c07bdf0d2680ffea4b5c47e4a87a5c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Demo update: Replays, Ranks, 3rd Ditch, ...
notes.notes:
We're back with great news! The demo has been updated with some major improvements! We have been working hard on the content for our full release, but we haven't forgotten about our demo. 

After 2 months, we thought an update was well due! So now it's here. What's new in this update? 

[list]
[b][*] Ranks[/b]Every level has it's own ranks based on time. Ranging from Apprentice to Fire Lord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/2b98402e998fdd8c8373c769aedc56a1ce68485f.gif[/img]

[b][*] A replay system + friends leaderboards[/b]Each leaderboard entry will be connected to the replay of that players run. Everyone can battle against each entry by clicking this entry and then battling. This will make their ghost appear in your level and you will have a direct look at their path. We also added a small icon that can be clicked to just show your Steam friends. Nothing is better than beating your friends in each level right? Now you have a handy overview of just your Steam friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/4526bdf953969488eb74bb03b4f0a849b2cf76af.gif[/img]
[b][*] 3rd Ditch[/b]A brand new level from the Circle of Fraud makes it way into Kick'n Hell. 3rd Ditch is another level set in the grim ditches of Fraud where you will have to make your way upwards in a very vertical based level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/d0a8aca9cbcd0f2ba7d04899f72dee6529564b3f.png[/img]
[b][*] Steam remote play for hotseat![/b]You can invite friends to play together! You can give everyone access to keyboard and mouse by using the remote play features. This is a bit chaotic because everyone has input at the same time, but we hope you can trust your friends on not ruining your run! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/a8cebd740e4f3a28ba38133c285c5dc8a19f5f5a.gif[/img]
[b][*] Level intro's [/b]Each level has a small video that showcases the whole level. This only plays on your first play or whenever you reset the level. Quick restarting won't trigger this video. They can also be disabled in your settings.

[b][*] Key rebinding[/b]All controls can be rebinded in the settings. We don't allow double binding, so no jumping, moving and kicking all on the same button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/78f562ed9ab80aeae3c6b92d706b8fd2409dfd11.png[/img]
[b][*] UI improvements[/b]Overal UI has been improved.

[b][*] Small difficulty ramping change[/b]We have adjusted the first few levels slightly, to make them less punishing and more fun to play. 
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/AxrcGBJDwm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/0d4d05ec38c07bdf0d2680ffea4b5c47e4a87a5c.png[/img][/url]
If you want to playtest new levels, chat with the devs, call out people from the leaderboards or you encounter bugs one adress: our [url=https://discord.gg/AxrcGBJDwm]discord server[/url]! 

And if you like the game, wishlist for when we release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832070/Kickn_Hell/

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, martial artists![/h1]

[h3]We have been at work to improve the demo version that's online. We have some changes that we want to share with you.
[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]2 brand new levels![/b] We added 2 'tutorial' levels. Let us know if these levels make you understand the game better!

[*] [b]A brand new gamemode![/b] We have added a hotseat gamemode, which allows you to play with other people locally. We would love to hear what you think of this concept and if you want to see it changed or improved in certain ways.

[*] [b]Overal clarity improved.[/b] Some aspects in the game were a bit vague. The red doors for example. We have included information which levels are not included in the demo.

[*] [b]Dash has been reworked![/b] The dash that is available in the last level has been changed to keep momentum. Furthermore it is now also completely based on the direction you are looking at. So no more dashing backwards!

[*] The [b]leaderboards[/b] now [b]display more unique characters[/b]. To the players with some unique characters like an underscore, your name will now display correctly. Unfortunately we don't have support for all languages. 

[*] [b]Sprint has become the default![/b] No more worrying over pressing shift, you will run automatically now and you can slow down with pressing shift. This is handy for a small jump or for adjusting your place slightly.

[*] [b]Leaderboards accessible from in-game[/b]. Check out the times of everyone from inside a level, no need to go to the main menu anymore!
[/list]

We have also fixed some bugs. If you encounter new bugs, report them in the [url=https://discord.gg/mq2eVsKt]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: What's in the works?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have been working hard and we want to share some points that we're working on! This includes demo updates as well as some work on the full version of the game.

[b]About the demo:[/b]
[list]
[*] We are working on[b] a new tutorial level[/b] to help fully understand [b]the brain mechanic[/b]. We noticed this was not clear and we hope this new level will help newer players get a grasp on the mechanic.
[*] We are making clear which levels are included in the demo and which aren't. We noticed players being confused by locked doors. This is not because you do something wrong, the levels are simply not in the demo.
[*] The dash is undergoing some tests to feel better during your speedrun.
[*] Sprinting default instead of walking. We are trying out to invert our movement. So that sprinting is default and you can slow down by pressing shift.
[*] Some bug fixes are also in the works, if you encounter bugs, be sure to let us know. This can be here on this announcement, on our Discord, on the feedback form. We appreciate it everywhere! 
[/list]

We are also working on newer levels and features for the full game. We don't want to give too much away, but here is a little sneak peek.
[b]About the full game:[/b]
[list]
[*] We are experimenting with a ghost mechanism to race against.
[*] Visually there are also some exciting upgrades to make the game feel a lot cooler.
[*] A giant tower level, where you ascend the inside of a medieval style building.
[*] ...and so much more.
[/list]

[b]But also:[/b]
We want to include [b]you[/b] in Kick'n Hell. We have skeletons in the game that are a part of the environment and the suffering in Hell. For everyone that streams or makes videos about our Demo, you can earn yourself a skeleton! 

How? 
Well when you stream or play the game, simply let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/pWGz7wT9]Discord [/url]server. If you played for a fair amount or you promoted the game to others, we want to thank you. Therefore we put your name in our game! You can be a skeleton in Kick'n Hell. Doesn't that sound cool?

We are still getting new feedback every day and we thank you for that! Without feedback the game would not improve as much as it could. So keep on giving feedback to improve Kick'n Hell!

Thanks already to all the players!
- Team Fire Foot
